SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.sale_amount), 0) FROM ( SELECT sr.id, sr.total_sale_amount AS sale_amount FROM biz_sale_record sr LEFT JOIN biz_sale_item si ON si.sale_record_id = sr.id AND si.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.business_date >= #{startDate} AND sr.business_date <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY sr.id, sr.total_sale_amount ) t

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.profit_amount), 0) FROM ( SELECT sr.id, sr.profit_amount FROM biz_sale_record sr LEFT JOIN biz_sale_item si ON si.sale_record_id = sr.id AND si.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.business_date >= #{startDate} AND sr.business_date <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY sr.id, sr.profit_amount ) t
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity), 0) FROM biz_inventory_batch b INNER JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = b.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity * b.unit_cost), 0) FROM biz_inventory_batch b INNER JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = b.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.business_date, '%m-%d') AS stat_date, COALESCE(SUM(t.sale_amount), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT sr.id, sr.business_date, sr.total_sale_amount AS sale_amount FROM biz_sale_record sr LEFT JOIN biz_sale_item si ON si.sale_record_id = sr.id AND si.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.business_date >= #{startDate} AND sr.business_date <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY sr.id, sr.business_date, sr.total_sale_amount ) t GROUP BY t.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.business_date, '%m-%d') AS stat_date, COALESCE(SUM(t.profit_amount), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT sr.id, sr.business_date, sr.profit_amount FROM biz_sale_record sr LEFT JOIN biz_sale_item si ON si.sale_record_id = sr.id AND si.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.business_date >= #{startDate} AND sr.business_date <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY sr.id, sr.business_date, sr.profit_amount ) t GROUP BY t.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date ASC

SELECT p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(si.sale_amount), 0) AS sale_amount, COALESCE(SUM(si.profit_amount), 0) AS profit_amount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(si.sale_amount), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(si.profit_amount), 0) / SUM(si.sale_amount) * 100, 2) END AS profit_rate FROM biz_sale_item si INNER JOIN biz_sale_record sr ON sr.id = si.sale_record_id AND sr.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE si.deleted = 0 AND sr.business_date >= #{startDate} AND sr.business_date <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name ORDER BY quantity DESC, sale_amount DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(si.sale_amount), 0) AS sale_amount, COALESCE(SUM(si.profit_amount), 0) AS profit_amount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(si.sale_amount), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(si.profit_amount), 0) / SUM(si.sale_amount) * 100, 2) END AS profit_rate FROM biz_sale_item si INNER JOIN biz_sale_record sr ON sr.id = si.sale_record_id AND sr.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE si.deleted = 0 AND sr.business_date >= #{startDate} AND sr.business_date <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name ORDER BY profit_amount DESC, sale_amount DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity), 0) AS inventory_quantity, p.warning_stock AS warning_value, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity), 0) = 0 THEN '缺货' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity), 0) <= p.warning_stock THEN '库存不足' ELSE '正常' END AS status FROM biz_product p LEFT JOIN biz_inventory_batch b ON b.product_id = p.id AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.warning_stock >= 0
GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name, p.warning_stock HAVING COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity), 0) <= p.warning_stock ORDER BY inventory_quantity ASC, p.id DESC LIMIT 10
